status: Prospectively fixed engineering stress scenarios after historical temporal results were inspected; not preregistration.
missing_policy: Mark source nutrients/lipids NaN; existing frozen training medians and missingness flags; regenerate engineered ratios using frozen transform. Missing lipid group includes stored NON_HDL_CHOL.
perturbation_policy: Multiplicative independent uniform errors: dietary [-10%,+10%], HDL and total cholesterol [-5%,+5%]; recompute non-HDL=max(total-HDL,0) after lipid noise; regenerate ratios. Chosen engineering magnitudes, not validated device/recall error distributions.
partial_missing: Independent 20% nutrient cells per row at fixed seeds 17 and 29; labels/participants unchanged.
scoring: Raw and frozen-calibrated AUROC, AP, Brier, diagnostic calibration slope/intercept; absolute probability change and decisions at fixed descriptive 0.5. No clinical cutoff or recalibration. Descriptive point estimates; no robustness significance claim.
limits: Selected NHANES cohort, unweighted; no Indian external validation; simulated missingness is not observed MNAR; no retraining or best-case selection.
